scope: durable scheduler, lease/heartbeat/orphan recovery, idempotent completion, cancellation, and indeterminate-effect safety

scheduler.test: EvaluationControlPlane durable authority schedules compatible runs fairly and respects retry backoff after a pre-execution expiry
EvaluationControlPlane durable authority honors priority, backend/provider limits, Worker resources, and the canonical lease ceiling
EvaluationControlPlane durable authority stops scheduling at token, cost, and wall-time budgets and durably blocks queued work
EvaluationControlPlane durable authority automatically retries only declared, observed-safe failure categories and persists failed attempts

leases.test: EvaluationControlPlane durable authority leases only compatible trials and makes result completion idempotent by hash
EvaluationControlPlane durable authority renews a live lease from the Control Plane clock and expires it only after the renewed deadline
Worker durable Control Plane integration runs Worker and lease heartbeats and reaps only its labelled orphan set on process start
Worker durable Control Plane integration classifies an in-flight trial indeterminate after hard Worker loss stops lease heartbeats
Worker durable Control Plane integration retries a lost result acknowledgement against the idempotent committed result

cancellation.test: EvaluationControlPlane durable authority requeues expired work only before any execution receipt and classifies ambiguous work indeterminate
EvaluationControlPlane durable authority classifies expired in-flight work during Control Plane restart and requires an explicit indeterminate retry confirmation
Worker durable Control Plane integration calls backend cancellation on timeout and commits a timeout only after cleanup
Worker durable Control Plane integration propagates durable run cancellation through a rejected lease heartbeat to the live Agent
